rationale: The plan correctly uses NB GLMs (DESeq2 Wald, edgeR QL, limma-voom as cross-checks) fit to the exact 3-vs-3 unpaired single-batch design, with explicit reference level and contrast direction, normalization performed inside each model, and BH-adjusted padj with apeglm/ashr shrinkage stated upfront rather than post hoc. QC (library size, PCA, sample distances, p-value histogram calibration) precedes the test with an explicit outlier policy, and the power/permutation audit (T2S1) is a rigorous, non-adjective answer to the n=3 confidence question that goes beyond the reference. Minor deductions: the low-count filter relies on DESeq2 independent filtering/edgeR filterByExpr without a single stated numeric justification comparable across methods, the dual-threshold (0.05/0.1) reporting slightly blurs a single stated alpha, and the report section never specifies software/package version numbers despite naming all tools and design/threshold/caveat elements thoroughly.
